verdict.rationale: Concurrency and throughput are fair questions for a local LLM runtime and server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions parallel request slots, continuous batching, or capacity reserved for concurrent sessions. The `lms load` GPU-offload and context-length flags and the on-demand model loading are related resource controls, not dedicated concurrent capacity, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
